name: native_font_release

ownership.argument: Consumes exactly one managed wrapper returned by native_font_create, after all label and native queued CPU glyph references have retired. Matching live manager required.
ownership.return_value: Return value is incidental and discarded. Frees wrapper and updates backing refcount; final ordinary backing font may move into native bounded idle cache, not be destroyed immediately. Does not release separately created fallback chains.

provenance.source: Exact-target IDA/Hex-Rays inspection and independently rehashed full raw AP function body; docs/native-ui-font-lifecycle-abi.md. Privileged host raw-address binding authorized by updated task B; no public veneer promotion.

notes: New native UI font integration identity only. Existing calendar/font-reload approvals and statuses remain unchanged. No device verification. Return value is incidental and discarded. Frees wrapper and updates backing refcount; final ordinary backing font may move into native bounded idle cache, not be destroyed immediately. Does not release separately created fallback chains.
